rationale: Allow at most 5% growth over the measured published module; review any increase with a source and consumer impact explanation. noyalib 0.0.61 measured 634,505 raw bytes (5.96% over 0.0.60; gzip 217,783, still within 5%): the core's YAML 1.2.2 parser fixes (flow continuation indentation, document-prefix BOMs, radix and tag resolution, typed key spelling) add scanner and loader code. The raw limit rises to 640,000 bytes (6.9%); the gzip limit, which governs transfer size, is unchanged.
